description: Find open volunteering missions (missions de bénévolat) near a French city or postal code, from JeVeuxAider.gouv.fr (the official public volunteering platform). Returns live missions with organization, commitment, places left, whether minors can apply, a direct signup URL, and — when the organization is identified by RNA — a link to its ia-asso.fr page. Use this when someone wants to BE a volunteer (donner de son temps), not when searching for an association in general. Coverage: JeVeuxAider missions only (~30k), non-exhaustive.

location.description: French city name or 5-digit postal code to search around. Omit only for remote missions.

open_to_minors.description: Only missions open to volunteers under 18

query.description: Keywords: theme, activity, audience (e.g. "lecture enfants", "maraude", "sport handicap").

radius.description: Search radius in km around the location (default: 25, max: 100)

remote.description: Only remote missions (à distance) — location is then ignored

name: find_volunteering_missions
